# Market Integrity candidate v1

Amounts use integer base units (uint256 bounded), ratios basis points, timestamps UTC milliseconds, velocity windows seconds. RIO ordinary concentration is 10 bps of eligible circulating supply; canonical authorized classifications can select only approved 20/30/40 bps ceilings. Accounting targets and client labels do not authorize. Disposal is constrained by spendable holdings and policy, without an acquisition ban. Native transfers also constrain the receiving wallet.

MaxTx is the minimum of transaction ceiling, concentration/spendable capacity, CPMM capacity, effective liquidity and cumulative velocity. Pool inputs and outputs use their actual asset units; fee-inclusive arithmetic and integer rounding are verified. Explicit inapplicability requires a policy reason. Missing policy/evidence blocks. Reservations span products, accounts and pools. Durable PostgreSQL transactions lock shared scopes, retry serialization conflicts within a bound, retain ambiguous capacity, enforce immutable decision events, and prevent indexer lag from releasing confirmed capacity prematurely. Production canonical providers must include all pending transactions, complete velocity history and all affected execution legs.

The gateway authenticates ownership through a server-owned adapter, decodes the exact execution, loads an approved versioned policy and authoritative state, reserves capacity, and signs an intent-bound receipt. Only registered public issuer keys verify receipts. Consumption needs an authentic receipt, a durable reserved row and canonical revalidation; replay is denied. No real issuer keys, user authentication backend, canonical account/pool provider or production policy is provisioned here. `policy-template.json` deliberately contains unresolved parameters and cannot authorize.

The SuperApp proxy verifies receipts and every protected mutating handler consumes one before execution. RioLight consumes one after local approval reservation and persistence, before accessing either mnemonic or seedless signing material. Indexer monetary endpoints remain unavailable until their approved provider exists. Vendored package bytes must match this directory.

`canonicalTWAP` integrates a verified pool's step price across complete observation-time coverage, with carry-in, minimum observations, maximum gaps and freshness. It never treats a trade average as TWAP. Its positive tests use explicit fixture policy; no production source is approved by them.

Pump accounting distinguishes 65,000 RUSD market capitalization, the 15,000 RUSD-equivalent seed and actual post-seed reserve surplus. The creator reserve is 10% of that surplus; stages reserve 5%, 2.5%, 2.5%, with buyer minimum/target pairs 200/250,250/400,600/1000. These are cumulative milestones, not exclusive eligibility windows. Canonical records also require 80% stable-equivalent/20% RIO settlement and vesting; the in-memory lifecycle store does not execute payouts or settle that conversion. Actual reward confirmation verifies chain identity, success, treasury, recipient and exact native/CW20 transfers. Canonical funding, genuine-buyer, graduation, LP and migration adapters remain required.

AI is advisory only. Bounded explainable signals contain evidence references, confidence and model version. Timeout, outage, malformed signals and contradictory model output cannot override deterministic limits. RioMind advisory integration does not claim a deployed L1 AI service; Nexus remains the separate public Prime experience.

**Unmet ecosystem gate:** direct L1 bank messages and existing deployed contracts have no universally activated MI keeper/contract gate. This package/API/wallet candidate is not evidence that those bypasses are prevented. Governance must approve canonical eligible-supply semantics, classifications/exemptions, policy values, authority enrollment, policy-update/reorg handling and the coordinated L1/contract enforcement design before activation. RUSD concentration/velocity limits and reserve-stage conflict (legacy 150% target vs controller 120% target and unused stage constants) remain unresolved; no substitute values are invented. No million-token/day capacity claim is made.
